Rashi on Niddah 11a:14:4.english: And the Torah declared it pure - [Throughout] all the days of purity.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:14:5.hebrew: שפיר - קתני מתניתין דלא בעיא בדיקה, דהא בין פסקה ובין לא פסקה, טמאה היום וטהורה למחר:
Rashi on Niddah 11a:14:5.english: It is well - The mishna teaches that she does not require an examination, for whether she stopped [bleeding] or did not stop, she is impure today and pure tomorrow.

Rashi on Niddah 11a:15:1.hebrew: אלא ללוי דאמר שני מעיינות הן - נפתח הטמא כל ימי הלידה ונסתם הטהור, ולסוף שבעה לזכר וי"ד לנקבה נסתם הטמא ונפתח הטהור. ואוקימנא התם, דשופעת מתוך שבעה לאחר שבעה ס"ל ללוי דאפילו בשמיני לעולם היא טמאה עד שתפסוק, דהא לא נסתם הטמא. תבדוק בשביעי, דילמא וכו':
Rashi on Niddah 11a:15:1.english: Rather, according to Levi, who said there are two sources - The impure [source] is open all the days of childbirth and the pure [source] is closed, and at the end of seven [days] for a male and fourteen for a female, the impure [source] is closed and the pure [source] is opened. And we established there that [in the case of a woman] who discharges continuously from within the seven [days] into after the seven, Levi holds that even on the eighth [day] she remains impure indefinitely until she stops [flowing], since the impure [source] did not close. [Therefore,] let her examine [herself] on the seventh [day], lest etc.
